summary: Iter50 - Etsy-style 'Info & Appearance' + Social Media + Account/Plan lifecycle for makers + Admin left-sidebar layout. Backend 11/11 pytest PASS. Frontend: all new sections (Info & Appearance fields, Social Media pills, Account & Plan with close/reopen/delete flows, Pending-deletion banner, Admin vertical sidebar at lg+) render and integrate correctly end-to-end.

issues: After any save that calls onSaved() (e.g. close-shop / reopen / request-delete / cancel-delete), the Settings sub-nav visually resets to the first section ('Info & Appearance') because the Account panel re-renders with fresh maker props. Not a correctness bug — state is right — but the user is bounced off the Account tab immediately after each action. Consider keeping activeSubnav across maker-refetches.

action_items: [optional UX] Preserve activeSubnav across maker refetch in SettingsTab so users stay on 'Account & Plan' after clicking close/reopen/delete/cancel.
critical_code_review_comments: [cosmetic] Test-request spec listed public-shop social pill testids as 'maker-social-{key}' but MakerDetail.jsx uses `data-testid={`maker-social-${l.key}`}` where l.key already has the 'social_' prefix — so the actual ids are 'maker-social-social_facebook' etc. Container 'maker-social-links' is fine. Either drop the 'social_' prefix from the key (`facebook`,`instagram`,…) or document the full id in the review_request so automated tests don't miss them.

[cosmetic] maker_request_deletion endpoint writes admin_audit with 'actor' + 'created_at' — most other maker-originated audit rows in this codebase use 'maker_slug' + 'ts'. Minor schema drift; consider normalizing.

[cosmetic] POST /maker/account/request-deletion also forces shop_closed=true (and vacation_mode=true) before writing the audit row. Cancel-deletion does NOT reopen the shop automatically — the user has to click 'Reopen' separately. That's intentional per copy, but worth noting: a user who cancels deletion will still appear closed until they explicitly reopen.

[minor UX] AccountPanel's close/reopen/delete actions each call onSaved() which re-fetches the maker and triggers a parent re-render that snaps active sub-nav back to 'info'. Low-priority but noticeable.
[cosmetic] Delete flow uses window.prompt('… type DELETE below:') — works but is browser-native and un-styleable. A proper modal would match the rest of the dark theme.

success_rate.frontend: 100% — Info & Appearance persist, Social pills all connected, Account & Plan close/reopen/delete/cancel-delete all PASS, Admin sidebar vertical at 1920px and horizontal-scroll at 390px, public shop shows title + announcement + closed-banner + social-links

test_credentials: Maker JWT minted fresh via maker_auth.issue_session_jwt('iron-and-oak',…,'maker'); Admin JWT via issue_session_jwt('admin','team@craftersmarket.org','admin').
seed_data_creation: Patched iron-and-oak Maker doc with shop_title / banner / announcement / msg_to_buyers / msg_digital / 6 social URLs + website_url. Toggled shop_closed on/off and deletion_requested_at on/off during test — all restored to clean state (shop_closed=false, no deletion pending) before finishing.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Testids: Settings sub-nav uses `settings-subnav-{id}` (NOT `subnav-{id}`). Social rows: `settings-social-{key}`, `settings-social-{key}-input`, `settings-social-{key}-status` where key is full like 'social_facebook'. Public-shop social pills: `maker-social-{key}` where key is again full 'social_facebook' → resulting id is `maker-social-social_facebook`. Account panel ops that mutate maker state trigger onSaved() which resets the sub-nav to first item — re-click `settings-subnav-account` after each action. request-deletion also closes shop; cancel-deletion does NOT auto-reopen — call reopen explicitly.
